decision.summary: Two regions stand out: (1) a large, persistent E-component offset starting near index 428 with incomplete recovery, and (2) a sharp, transient U-component drop near index 608–610 with rapid rebound. Both show cross-axis coupling but differ in duration and recovery behavior. Other intervals exhibit ordinary noise or smooth motion.

regions.observation: Sharp ~7.5 MAD downward step in E-component (centered) at ~index 428, followed by sustained offset and noisy recovery; N and U show correlated transient dip but no persistent shift. Ambiguous whether E returns fully—recovery appears partial and noisy through index 435.

Multi-sample abrupt drop (~3 MAD) in U-component at ~index 608–610, coincident with smaller opposing dip in E and neutral N; U recovers rapidly by index 613 but leaves a subtle platform until ~615. Cross-axis shape suggests brief vertical offset with possible elastic rebound signature.
